label: PF Backlog 418
title: PF platform delivery baseline: ONE source for all editions; new shipped/sensitive logic -> Go; existing -> compiled (Nuitka); no raw .py at customer; migrate by value later
body: LOCKED delivery baseline (Go-first for new work): ONE source for all editions. NEW features -> Go (from day one; Go core B1 is mandatory). EXISTING Python -> shipped compiled (Nuitka). High-value legacy modules -> migrated to Go later by value (BI-PF-0386). No raw .py at the customer; build COMPILES (go build / Nuitka), never translates; one implementation per feature. Full Python->Go rewrite = non-goal/aspiration (compiled Python fallback for low-value remainder). SaaS runs the source; customer ships the compiled artifact + license.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing delivery pipeline: enforce Go for new shipped/sensitive code (BI-PF-0394 B1 core), Nuitka-compile existing Python (core/delivery.py, budget_allocator, call_ledger, id_allocator), wire /api/v1/packaging/editions to build profiles; document baseline as enforceable policy.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-0388 ADR accepted (explicit EXISTING deps)
conflict_findings: BI-PF-0398 A3 also touches packaging/signing — coordinate to avoid two gates
duplication_findings: Absorbs/overlaps BI-PF-0383 (NO-RAW-.py gate) — ensure single implementation
BI-PF-0398 A3 builds the packaging enforcement; 0387 states the policy
analysis.rationale: Reuses existing delivery/packaging APIs and modules; enforces locked baseline rather than building new components.
assumptions: BI-PF-0394 Go core B1 lands as foundation
risks: Policy vs enforcement split may leave gaps if A3 not aligned
evidence: Candidate components and editions API confirm existing extension points
missing_info: Which modules count as 'sensitive' (depends on BI-PF-0386)
